"Not yet," she said. "Plum trees take about four years to give fruit. You must water them, protect them from the wind, and wait." Leo groaned, but he dug the hole. Mrs. Alvarez tied a yellow ribbon to a stake beside it, so no one would trip over the young tree. All summer he watered it, and in fall and winter he checked the stake after every storm.
